youtube.title: Why Pen Caps Have A Tiny Hole 😮 #Shorts
youtube.description:
A tiny hole in pen caps isn't for the ink. It's there so you can still breathe if you swallow one. 😮

Pen-cap holes are a safety standard (ISO 11540): a cap small enough to swallow must let air through.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
